title: Among users with the lowest reputation, find those who authored posts in 20
question: Among users with the lowest reputation, find those who authored posts in 2011 with view counts between 100 and 150. For each such post, identify its highest-scoring comment. Return the text of the single highest-scoring comment across all these posts, along with the display name of the user who wrote that comment and the title of the associated post.

prediction.sql:
WITH MinRepUsers AS (
    SELECT "XCL_052" AS uid FROM users WHERE "XCL_053" = (SELECT MIN("XCL_053") FROM users)
),
FilteredPosts AS (
    SELECT p."XCL_026" AS pid, p."XCL_035" AS title
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN MinRepUsers m ON p."XCL_033" = m.uid
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p."XCL_029") = '2011'
      AND p."XCL_030" BETWEEN 100 AND 150
)
SELECT c."XCL_008" AS comment_text, u."XCL_055" AS display_name, fp.title
FROM comments c
INNER JOIN FilteredPosts fp ON c."XCL_006" = fp.pid
INNER JOIN users u ON c."XCL_010" = u."XCL_052"
ORDER BY c."XCL_007" DESC
LIMIT 1
